motivation: To prevent small inconsistencies from accumulating in a knowledge vault when using AI coding assistants, ensuring human oversight of AI-generated content.
problem: AI coding assistants introduce inconsistencies and untrustworthy files into the vault, requiring a mechanism for human verification.
